finding: Credit line stress persists despite easing Slovak bank loan conditions
bullets: The Slovak credit line gap held at +15.3pp (n=270), 1.3pp above the EA, as rising need (+15.2pp) outweighed near-flat availability (-0.1pp) — the most stressed instrument for Slovak firms.
The bank loan gap deepened to -6.0pp (n=214) from -4.0pp in the prior wave, 8.8pp below the EA's +2.8pp, as availability improved to +5.6pp — signalling tighter conditions for Slovak firms.
The trade credit gap improved by 8.0pp to -1.7pp (n=180), driven by a sharp fall in need from +7.1pp to -3.4pp, leaving SK 12.7pp less stressed than the EA.
chart_subtitle: Slovak credit line gap at +15.3pp, bank loans at -6.0pp.
